steps.say: Pieces move one square diagonally forward. Click any of your pieces, then the square it should move to.
If you can jump an enemy piece, you must. Jump over it to take it off the board.
steps.tip: Your piece on h4 can jump the one next to it.

steps.say: After a jump, if you can jump again, keep going. Take two pieces in one move.
steps.tip: Start with the piece on a7 and click each landing square.
